cs.t: I use ergonomic low-profile split keyboard Sweep[1]. My endgame (I hope so) keyboard after a long journey through the ergomechboard rabbit hole. If you're interesting in improving keyboard ergonomics with really custom solutions, r/ErgoMechBoards's Wiki [2] is a good place to start. [1]:  https://github.com/davidphilipbarr/Sweep  [2]:  https://www.reddit.com/r/ErgoMechKeyboards/wiki/resources
